Running pnpm install --prefer-offline there wrote 3 insertions into pnpm-lock.yaml. assertionJustification.reasonForRemoval: These assertions test the wording of a human-readable reason string (prose), not the step's behaviour. Rewording the sentence makes the suite fail with no behaviour change; breaking the step's behaviour while keeping the sentence leaves them green. They protect nothing and punish editing a comment.
survivingClauses: expect(step).not.toBeNull() — step is created when relevant paths are staged
expect(buildLockfileDriftStep(["apps/ui-xr/src/main.ts"])).toBeNull() — step correctly omitted for non-manifest paths
expect(buildLockfileDriftStep(["PROJECT_STATUS.md"])).toBeNull() — step correctly omitted for coordination-only paths
expect(buildLockfileDriftStep([])).toBeNull() — step correctly omitted for empty staged set
assertionJustification.whatNowFailsIfBehaviourChanges: If the step's firing condition changes (LOCKFILE_DRIFT_RELEVANT_PATH), the four path-scope clauses fail. If the emitted command changes, the command clause fails. If the step is emitted for non-manifest paths, the null-return clauses fail. The step's identity (when it fires and what it runs) is fully covered.
